title: Compositor sets wrong barrier for multi-dispatch compute
body: ### Tested versions v4.4.1.stable.mono.official [49a5bc7b6] ### System information Godot v4.4.1.stable.mono - Windows 11 (build 22631) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.8088) - AMD Ryzen 9 7900X 12-Core Processor (24 threads) ### Issue description I'm working on a custom 2D post-processing workflow. Firstly, I want to write a simple blur effect, which needs three dispatches (blur horizontal -> blur vertical -> write back to screen). But the output is not as expected. I use the RenderDoc to capture a frame. And the final dispatch is excluded from the compute pass. I also use the Nsight. It shows that the barrier of the last dispatch is set at a wrong position. Then I add a simple tint compositor after the blur compositor, the blur effect works correctly. Tint disable (blur also failed) Tint enable (blur works) I also tried to disable the vertical blur dispatch and run the rest 2 dispatches. The output is correct in my Nvidia GPU. But it still failed in my AMD integrated GPU. ### Steps to reproduce See MRP. Disable/Enable the TintCompositor in the WorldEnvironment's Compositor to see how the last blur compositor works. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [compositor_wrong_barrier.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/21766833/compositor_wrong_barrier.zip)
